chapter: California, Cats and the Fiddle, the Tatum trio
title: Streets of Paris: how the trio with Tatum and Slam Stewart formed
summary: A club owner spots them jamming for free and puts a trio together at the Streets of Paris; they gathered at the Big Leg Chicken after hours.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: And we didn't even realize it. He'd let a group of people out, the place would fill up + we played. No brains. Play and play and play. Till some guy spotted us. in [from?] The Streets of Paris, out on Hollywood and Vine and induced him to put a trio together. And It was a hit right off the reel.
I wasn't the entertainer that Slim Gaillard was --

Slim and I, when we got through playing, thats where we'd end up. Everybody else would be there. They called it Big Leg Chicken. And we would all just gather. It was a gatherin' place. So we started bringin' our instruments down just playin' to have something to do. That's when Fats came in. All I know is he was playin' and somehow or another he didn't mind us joinin' in, or somethin' like that. And the trio formed right from there, thats all I can remember.
* I don't even know who brought him there or how we met, I can't even remember that part.
No formal introduction, and all that stuff. "Is it all right we sit in and play, man" "yeah" That was that.
